tools.name: get_installation_guide
tools.description: Get public instructions for installing Kawl Now’s Support or Sales website integration through ChatGPT or Codex. No sign-in is needed for this guide. Connect the selected brand through browser OAuth before reading account status or configuring it. Never ask for passwords, API keys or verification co

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Read this brand and agent’s setup checklist, published installation check, knowledge review, private browser test and call enablement. A saved static check is not proof of browser execution or audio.

tools.name: configure_setup
tools.description: Save setup-safe agent fields and atomically merge public production HTTPS allowedOrigins, preserving existing settings. Permitted settings: productName, agentName, greeting, instructions, voice, widgetLabel, accentColor, agentConfigured. Cannot approve knowledge, enable calls, change phone destinati

tools.name: verify_installation
tools.description: Check a published public HTTPS page for one matching classic widget script, allowed website origin and definite browser policy blocks. Bounded static inspection only; dynamic markup may be inconclusive. Does not start calls or prove microphone audio, handover or browser execution.

tools.name: import_website
tools.description: Import public website pages as unapproved knowledge for Support only, Sales only, or Both agents. Use scan_website and import_website_pages to choose pages from a scan of up to 250 pages. Full text is split into complete sources within brand capacity. Existing sourceId refreshes that page and remove

tools.name: scan_website
tools.description: Discover up to 250 readable public website pages without saving knowledge. Returns a short-lived brand/audience-bound preview and page metadata. Respect reported scan and brand capacity limits; use import_website_pages to save selected pages for review.

tools.name: import_website_pages
tools.description: Save all or selected URLs from a prior scan_website preview as complete unapproved drafts for its selected audience. The server owns the preview contents; import never trusts caller-supplied text. The complete selection must fit brand/account capacity.

tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Read a source including its full imported text for review before approving it.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Read this brand’s settings and connection status. OAuth setup connections receive only safe setup fields and eligible knowledge metadata; no transcripts, keys, billing or destinations.

tools.name: add_knowledge
tools.description: Add a document for Support only, Sales only, or Both agents. New documents require review before use.

tools.name: sync_github
tools.description: Import or refresh one GitHub text file for Support only, Sales only, or Both agents. Use scan_github and import_github_files to scan a repository and choose multiple files. Review the complete text for confidential information before approval. Every refresh removes approval. Pass sourceId to bind re

tools.name: scan_github
tools.description: Scan a GitHub repository at a pinned default-branch commit and list eligible text and source-code files. Does not import or execute repository code. Private repository access is checked against the brand’s server-owned allowlist.

tools.name: import_github_files
tools.description: Import selected files from a scan_github preview as complete unapproved drafts, split into sources when needed. Reads immutable verified blobs and saves the whole selection atomically within account/brand limits. Review before exact-revision approval.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: List workspace knowledge metadata and approval status.

tools.name: get_installation
tools.description: Get the support or sales embed and its allowed website origins.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_installation_guide" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
